descriptions.value: In getChppAppState of chpp_init.cc, there is a possible way to trigger an out of bounds read and corrupt task control structures due to a missing permission check. This could lead to local escalation of privilege with no additional execution privileges needed. User interaction is not needed for exploitation.
Android on supported Pixel devices before security patch level 2026-11-05 allows elevation of privilege in the hypervisor subcomponent in the kernel, aka A-519434175.
